defect: A stray "IMPLEMENTATION NOTES" scratch comment block was left in the test table (promql/engine_test.go:1776-1784).
Missing test coverage for a subquery whose range is longer than the query step.
Two identical "PHASE 3: RANGE QUERY + SUBQUERY COMBINATIONS" test groups exist (promql/engine_test.go:2066 and 2135).
The new tests in the "ENHANCED SUBQUERY TESTING" section are near-duplicates of each other with no stated distinct purpose.

MergeSamplesReadFromSubquery merges per-step counts index-by-index, wrongly assuming a 1:1 child-step to parent-step mapping, and does not do incremental attribution across parent steps (util/stats/query_stats.go:423-433).

Wrong expected sample count for sum_over_time(metricWith1SampleEvery10Seconds[30s:30s]) at T=90s: 2 instead of 1, because the subquery's read is double-counted with the outer read (promql/engine_test.go:1548-1551).
The subquery evaluation produces an inner step beyond the last one required by the outer query, inflating the last parent step's count (promql/engine_test.go:1432).
Wrong expected sample count for the parent step at T=261s (should be 3).
require.GreaterOrEqual(qs.Samples.SamplesRead, int64(0)) is a vacuous assertion that passes on an unset zero value (web/api/v1/api_test.go:983, 999).
An unrelated cleanup, the deletion of the unused defaultEpsilon constant in promql/engine_test.go, is bundled into this PR.
